notes.general_comments: General comments A total of 1130 candidates took this paper. The results were in line with the June paper, but still disappointing with only 46% of candidates achieving a score of 15 or more out of 30. The median score was 14, with the mean slightly higher. Some questions proved easy to candidates, with Questions 12, 16, 17, 21, 23 and 29 answered correctly by 60% or more of candidates.
